The '''Wasted Plains''' was an expanse of black sand on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taskeed/Legends|Taskeed]]. The plains bordered the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] at [[Yefowr]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
